**Company Overview**
 KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world\-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.
   

  

**Team Overview**
 The ADAPT (AI, Data, and Platform Technologies) Engineering team is integral to KKR's technological strategy, architecting and supporting the firm's foundational data and AI capabilities. This team is recognized as a key enabler for global scale and business transformation, driving excellence by evolving technology into robust, platform\-based solutions that enhance agility and deliver material business impact.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 KKR is seeking a
 **Software Engineer** 
 to join the core Data Platform Engineering team in Boston or NYC. This individual will serve as the technical anchor for the team responsible for
 **Data Explorer** 
 , the firm’s primary governed data exchange platform, and for the data solutions that form the platform’s intelligence layer.
   

  

 Data Explorer is evolving from an internal data catalog into a unified, governed interface for discovering and accessing structured data products, AI\-powered document analysis, business intelligence assets, and secure external client data. In parallel, the team is building unified Data Rooms and AI\-powered analytics experiences that provide users with governed answers and insights—not simply access to raw tables and reports.
   

  

 This is a pivotal, hands\-on technical leadership role with ownership of the end\-to\-end architecture across modern web applications, API and service layers, cloud data platforms, identity and access controls, AI\-enabled user experiences, and business intelligence integrations. The successful candidate will set engineering standards, mentor senior engineers, and lead the team through its most complex cross\-cutting design challenges, including external\-facing security, AI and user\-experience integration, and BI platform consolidation.
   

  

 The role operates within a Data Engineering and Data Operations model in which Data Operations owns business requirements and roadmap priorities—the “what”—while the Principal Software Engineer leads technical design, implementation strategy, and engineering execution—the “how.”
   

  

 This is an onsite role, with an expectation of working from KKR’s Boston office four days per week, or the New York City office five days per week.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the technical architecture and guide roadmap execution for Data Explorer, including its React and TypeScript front end, solution backend, API and service layers, and cloud data integrations.
* Translate product and operational priorities into scalable technical designs across Data Explorer’s core capability areas: report consolidation, persona\-based landing experiences, Sigma integration, AI and Data Rooms, external client access, and administrative and user\-support capabilities.
* Lead the design and delivery of secure external client access, including dedicated authentication flows, client\-specific entitlements through Saviynt, and simplified user experiences for non\-KKR users.
* Establish secure, scalable access patterns for external clients and constituents, including ABF, TPA, and LP users, within a SOX\-aligned control environment.
* Build the AI\-powered data solutions layer, including unified Data Rooms that replace legacy data collections and provide governed access to structured data models and indexed document repositories.
* Deliver embedded, chat\-based natural\-language experiences that allow users to query structured and unstructured data, analyze documents, and receive contextual answers and insights.
* Integrate Data Explorer with KARA 3\.0 and the firm’s agent marketplace, enabling Data Operations teams to deploy governed, business\-facing agents through the platform rather than through bespoke application builds.
* Drive BI consolidation and integration by establishing native Sigma and Power BI experiences within the Data Explorer inventory, supporting the retirement of the legacy report engine, and evaluating Sigma\-based interactive exploration as an alternative to the existing AG Grid Data Access experience.
* Data distribution as part of the Unified Data Fabric team to consume governed Gold\-layer data products and ensure that platform experiences align with enterprise data product, metadata, lineage, quality, and interoperability standards.
* Integrate Data Explorer with the firm’s persona and access\-package entitlement model, working closely with ADAPT Engineering teams responsible for data fabric, MKS, Saviynt, and related platform capabilities.
* Define reusable architecture and engineering patterns for APIs, authentication, authorization, data access, AI integration, observability, testing, deployment, and operational support.
* Ensure that the platform meets enterprise expectations for security, reliability, performance, scalability, auditability, data classification, and regulatory controls.
* Set the engineering bar through architecture reviews, technical standards, design documentation, code quality practices, and mentorship of senior engineers and technical leads.
* Lead complex cross\-team design decisions and resolve architectural issues that span application engineering, data engineering, AI, identity, BI, infrastructure, and operational workflows.
* Partner with engineering, product, architecture, analytics, Data Operations, and business leaders to sequence investments, manage technical dependencies, and align delivery with the firm’s broader data and analytics strategy.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and market developments in AI\-powered analytics, agent platforms, data discovery, BI integration, identity, and enterprise data platforms, translating relevant developments into practical architectural recommendations.
